summary: Line runs between houses and gardens, not along a drivable road.
reasons: No road visible under the line
Private gardens, no room to stop

drivers.seclusion: Houses press in on both sides, with dwellings 4 m at 62 m, 10 m at 40 m and 12 m at the start.
drivers.access_and_room: The line crosses garden land and a footpath-width gap between lots; no formed road or pull-off a van can use.
drivers.traffic: Not applicable; no road along the line.
drivers.convention: No parked vehicles or tracks on the line.

flags: Creek about 20 m away, elevation about 31 m
sun_shade: Tree canopy and house shade over most of the line.
cannot_judge: Whether the gap is a public path or easement
